evidence_sources.excerpt: Simon Armitage's translation of Sir Gawain and the Green Knight is exceptional, much better IMO than the Tolkien translation. So I'm very excited for this. The audio performance of it by Bill Wallis is also a family favorite:

source_story_title: Gilgamesh by Simon Armitage review – an ancient epic is brilliantly translated
